name: Quarters
description: A pay-per-use AI tool companion with a NEAR Coin Jar for mock-USDC purchases. An MCP service negotiates HTTP 402 paywalls for research and chart tools, while the jar meters spending and credits approved providers.
problem: People who use premium AI tools occasionally still face recurring subscriptions. Agents need a way to pay for individual results while operating inside a user's spending policy.
userFlow: Run npm run test:contract from the repository root with Node.js 20 or later. See the dependency-free contract harness run.
Follow the faucet and dispense tests. See a $5.00 mock-USDC grant, a $0.05 purchase, a provider credit, and a single receipt even when the request is retried.
Follow the guardrail tests. See an unregistered provider, a $10.00 payment attempt, and a purchase above the rolling $2.00 cap rejected.
Run npm ci --omit=dev and npm run test:vending. See both MCP tools negotiate a local HTTP 402 paywall, report optimistic payment, and return results after simulated settlement.
